_meta.name: Global mean sea level
_meta.source: computed from NOAA STAR satellite altimetry
_meta.note: Each published observation is the mean of the altimeter missions reporting on that date (TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason-1, Jason-2, Jason-3, Sentinel-6MF overlap at handovers); the annual value is the arithmetic mean of a calendar year's observations, 1993 onward; original reference baseline retained, no rebasing. Inter-mission offsets exist across satellite altimeter generations; the reference-series baseline is retained.
_meta.breaks: Inter-mission offsets exist across satellite altimeter generations; the reference-series baseline is retained.
_meta.annualRule: Calendar-year mean of subannual observations; at least ten observations required. The latest year is excluded until it meets the full-year coverage requirement.
